title: Flow Minimap Bounded Rectangle Drag
description: On flow minimap LOD, add bounded rectangle drag like puzzle 2d: dragging works from any point inside the selection bounding rectangle without hitting individual nodes.
summary: Added minimap LOD bounded rectangle drag for flow DAG: pointer-down inside the padded union AABB of the current selection starts a group drag without requiring a discrete node hit, matching puzzle 2d. Introduced GraphEngine::try_begin_selection_union_drag_at and wired DagHost minimap pointer-down to call it before discrete hit testing. Added Rust unit tests in mathematical_graph and dag host.
